name: 西游记450
english_description: A distribution package built specifically for setting up "mirror sites," complete with a tutorial for other site operators to launch their own branch on top of it. It belongs to the same closely related "Journey to the West / xiyouji.org" engine family as this project's xyj2000f, mhxy, and mhxyqd — its core engine files (master.c, chinese.c, and others) are nearly word-for-word identical to mhxy, differing only in the site's own login/security layer and world content. Set in the Journey to the West universe, players start at the South City Inn in Chang'an and explore the three realms while practicing martial arts and joining sects; as a mirror-site package its world closely resembles the xyj2000f/mhxy line but runs its own independent registration and security system.
